I enclose my translation of Menabrea's paper, with the **notes** you suggested. They have grown longer than the paper itself, and I hope you will forgive me that.

Note G in particular sets out how the Engine might compute the numbers of Bernoulli. Please look it over before it goes to Taylor.

~~~
$kind: postscript
~~~

The diagrams follow by the evening post.
